in_arabic.name: اورنگزیب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الملك الفائز دائما، هذا الاسم مشتق من اللغة الفارسية، ويتكون من كلمتين، أورنگ التي تعني العرش، وزیب التي تعني الزين، ولهذا فإن الاسم يرمز إلى الملك الفائز الذي يزين عرشه دائما، وله تاريخ عريق في الثقافة الإسلامية، خاصة في العصر المغولي

in_urdu.name: اورنگزیب
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام فارسی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور دو الفاظ اورنگ اور زيب سے مل کر بنا ہے، جہاں اورنگ کا مطلب تخت ہے اور زيب کا مطلب زینت، اور اس طرح یہ نام ہمیشہ کامیاب بادشاہ کی علامت ہے جو اپنے تخت کو سجاتا ہے، اور اس کا اسلامی ثقافت میں خاص طور پر مغلیہ دور میں ایک گہرا اثر ہے

in_hindi.name: औरंगज़ेब
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम फ़ारसी भाषा से लिया गया है, और दो शब्दों औरंग और ज़ेब से मिलकर बना है, जहां औरंग का अर्थ सिंहासन है और ज़ेब का अर्थ सजावट, और इस प्रकार यह नाम सदा विजयी राजा का प्रतीक है जो अपने सिंहासन को सजाता है, और इसका इस्लामी संस्कृति में विशेष रूप से मुगल काल में एक गहरा प्रभाव है

in_pashto.name: اورنگزیب
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم له فارسي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی، او د دوو کلمو اورنگ او زیب څخه جوړ شوی، چېرې چې اورنگ معنا تخت دی او زیب معنا ښکلا، نو ځکه دا نوم دايم بریالای شاہ دی چې خپل تخت ښکلی کوي، او دا نوم د اسلامی کلتور کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري، đặc biệt د مغولي دور په دوران کې

in_english.name: Aurangzeb
in_english.long_meaning: this name is derived from the Persian language, and consists of two words, aurang and zeb, where aurang means throne and zeb means ornament, and thus this name symbolizes the always victorious king who adorns his throne, and has a deep significance in Islamic culture, especially in the Mughal era

data.cultural_impact: The name Aurangzeb is synonymous with the Mughal Empire in India, as it was the name of one of its most powerful and influential rulers, Emperor Aurangzeb. He ruled from 1658 to 1707, making him the third longest reigning monarch in the history of the Mughal Empire. Aurangzeb is considered a architectural patron, as he commissioned the construction of many notable buildings, including the Badshahi Mosque in Lahore, Pakistan, and the Kerala Backwaters in India. He also played a significant role in the development of the Urdu language, as it became the language of the courts during his reign.
data.spiritual_significance: Aurangzeb's name suggests a deep spiritual connection to wisdom and power. In Islamic context, the name can be interpreted as allusion to the eternal and infinite nature of God, Almighty. It conveys the idea that true wisdom and power comes from a deep connection to the divine, and that Aurangzeb's rule was guided by this spiritual foundation. This is reflected in his efforts to promote the spread of Islam, patronize religious scholars, and maintain the peace and security of his realm. The name Aurangzeb can serve as a reminder to seek spiritual guidance and inner wisdom in times of personal and collective leadership.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aurangzeb' continues to be a subject of interest in various modern contexts. In the realm of academia, it is often discussed in the context of Mughal history, particularly in relation to his military conquests and rule. In Indian politics, his name is invoked in debates over secularism and communalism. In media and entertainment, Aurangzeb is depicted in various TV shows, books, and films, often as a complex and controversial figure. His controversial aspects include his religious policies, military conquests, and treatment of his family.
